description: Every field a call to notes may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

categories.description: the categories the views start with: `general = General brown` (where new notes go), `memory = Memory green` (shown only under the memories button; none when left out), then one line a listed one, `Space brown` or `"Machine Learning" brown`, and `color = gray` for a new one

imports.description: modules the conformances import, such as the package a mapped type is declared in

into.description: the folder for the views, relative to the project; Components/Notes when left out

launch.description: `destination = state` for a launch with `-destination <name>`: grid, memories, categories, new, or editor and a note's id or title (`note = editor space-001`)

look.description: `role = Swift`, the app's names for the look: accent, card, cardShadow, buttonShadow, panel, titleColor, noteColor (colours); title, note, note2, cardTitle, cardDate, cardText, cardCategory, editorTitle (fonts); a role left out keeps the original's value

mappings.description: one line a role (note, category): `note: Note title=title body=body category=category date=createdAt new=Note(id: UUID().uuidString, title: "", body: "", category: "General", createdAt: Date())`; a bare path is read off the value and written back, anything else is Swift that may name `value`

motion.description: `key = animation` (`library.filter = .bouncy`) or `key = seconds` (`editor.deleteDelay = 0.6`); every key has a default

prefix.description: a prefix for the kit's types when the app already has those names: `Kit` writes KitNotesLibrary

sizes.description: `key = number`, any size in points, count or fraction (`grid.minimum = 160`, `picker.detent = 0.6`); every key has a default

strings.description: `key = text`, any word the views show (`library.title = Library`); `|` between the items of a list key (`editor.titlePlaceholder`); every key has a default

symbols.description: `key = name`, any SF Symbol the views draw (`library.new = plus`); every key has a default
